missing_window_policy: abort; preserve the complete original cohort without error-based exclusions
support_rule: single/speed/load/direction: repeat 0 to 1; repeat control retains canonical [0,1] supports
query_rule: repeat 1 to 0 at identical requested condition and duration
scope: Frozen 120-budget models, original training-only scaler and original fitted baseline libraries/coefficients. No refit, new selection, feature/QC change, raw download or reserved specimen access. Complete original development cohorts and all 15 protocol/duration cells. Descriptive two-group sensitivity; reversal changes both support recording and target recording, so effects cannot isolate either source.
